newsitem.title: USA: Manpower Q1 net rises as Europe recovers.
newsitem.headline: Manpower Q1 net rises as Europe recovers.

text.p: Manpower Inc said Thursday recovering strength in Europe and record domestic revenues helped the company post solid growth in its earnings in the first quarter ended March 31.
The temporary personnel services company posted net income of $26.6 million, or $0.32 a share, compared to $23.2 million, or $0.28, in the corresponding period last year.
Systemwide sales rose to $1.9 billion from $1.6 billion, Manpower said.
Manpower cited recovering strength in France and Germany for giving the comapny a "good start" into 1997.
Manpower shares were up 1-3/8 Thursday at 39-7/8.
